🚀 gridex | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a single, unified, and efficient application for developers and database administrators to connect to, query, and manage multiple types of databases across different operating systems.
✨ Key Features: • Cross-platform support (macOS, Windows, Linux) • Support for multiple databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, SQL Server, ClickHouse)
📖 Summary: Gridex is a cross-platform database IDE for macOS, Windows, and Linux, supporting a wide range of databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, SQL Server, and ClickHouse. It offers a unified interface for managing these databases, featuring a built-in MCP server and AI chat capabilities.
